config.name: batch.maxnumber
config.description: the max number of chassis that can be created in one batch job

config.name: deletionPolicy
config.description: the behavior of deleting a baremetal instance, options are [Direct, Delay]. Direct: delete the baremetal instance from database; Delay: change the bm's state to Destroyed in database; after the period controlled by 'expungePeriod' passes, delete the bm from database.

config.name: expungePeriod
config.description: the period before a destroyed baremetal instance being deleted from database, in seconds

config.name: expungeInterval
config.description: the interval the expunging baremetal instance task runs, in seconds

config.name: ping.interval
config.description: The interval management server sends ping command to baremetal pxeserver, in seconds

config.name: ping.parallelismDegree
config.description: The max number of baremetal pxeserver that management server sends ping commands in parallel

config.name: reservedCapacity
config.description: The reserved capacity on all baremetal pxeserver

config.name: pxeserver.allow.ports
config.description: tcp or udp ports allowed by pxe server, udp port start with 'u' like 'u67', port range can be like this: 1100:1200, multiple port or port range can be separated by ”,“
